blocks._note: Rounded boxes alternating white and purple. The four sections are questions a student asks in order, so they read as a sequence. Each carries one photo from the "become an instructor" Drive folder, inline with the words rather than gathered into a carousel, so a visitor sees all four without clicking anything. Every section names its photograph, because which one belongs beside which question was chosen by eye and folder order is not it — see §7A.2. Naming all four rather than only the pair that moved keeps a deletion in Drive from shuffling the ones that did not. A fifth photo joins the last section.
